title: osu! folder
description: Absolute stable installation folder for offline rendering. Leave empty to follow the active osu! client. Songs, Skins and Replays are read only.

title: Songs folder override
description: Optional absolute Songs folder, including installations with a custom BeatmapDirectory.

title: Offline skin
description: Skin folder name under Skins, used when the active client has no current skin.

title: Default mania scroll speed
description: Default for replay tracks without a player preset. Per-replay overrides never modify osu! settings.

title: Default resolution
description: WIDTHxHEIGHT for new compositions and CLI renders, e.g. 1920x1080, 2560x1440, 3440x1440 or 1080x1920 (vertical). Even sides, 64–7680 px, at most 7680×4320 pixels.

title: Default frame rate
description: Frames per second for new renders (1–240).

title: Outro (ms)
description: Time the video keeps running after the last object; the picture and sound fade out at its end. lazer shows results after 1250 ms.

title: Fade (ms)
description: Length of the fade to black at the end of the outro (lazer: 250).

title: Output folder
description: Absolute folder for rendered MP4 files named in the studio. Leave empty to use your Videos folder.

title: Video encoder
description: Auto probes hardware H.264 encoding and falls back to software. Hardware requires a working GPU encoder; software always uses libx264. The render job reports the encoder actually used.

title: FFmpeg executable
description: Absolute path to ffmpeg (ffmpeg.exe on Windows). Leave empty to use VOSU_RENDER_FFMPEG or ffmpeg on PATH.
